findings.passage: Minnesotans are asking us to do something to prevent future gun deaths
findings.note: House member newsletter written in her name, after the Annunciation shooting; she describes bills proposed to ban assault weapons, high-capacity magazines and binary triggers, require safe storage, and require reporting of lost or stolen guns.

findings.passage: I voted in favor of legislation to keep ICE out of schools, ban assault weapons, and ban high-capacity magazines.
findings.note: Newsletter in her name saying she voted for bills to ban assault weapons and high-capacity magazines, which she says were blocked in committee.

findings.passage: I joined my colleagues for a sit-in on the House Floor for 39 hours as we pressured Speaker Lisa Demuth to schedule a vote on the Senate’s comprehensive gun violence proposal.
findings.note: End-of-session newsletter in her name; she describes joining a 39-hour floor sit-in for a vote on a package she says includes an assault weapons ban, safe storage proposals, mental health and school safety funding.

findings.passage: We could have saved lives with an assault weapons ban and safe storage requirements.
findings.note: Summer newsletter in her name looking back on the session; she names an assault weapons ban and safe storage requirements as measures that were not passed.
